name: mt-cadastral-change-worker
description: The Cloudflare Worker that serves the Montana cadastral dashboard and its assistant endpoint.

scripts.dev:seed-basemap: wrangler r2 object put mt-cadastral-basemap/mt-basemap.pmtiles --file site/public/basemap/mt-basemap.pmtiles --content-type application/octet-stream --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix site && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:basemap: wrangler r2 object put mt-cadastral-basemap/mt-basemap.pmtiles --file site/public/basemap/mt-basemap.pmtiles --content-type application/octet-stream --remote
scripts.deploy:pages: node pages/stage.mjs && cd pages && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.test: npm run test:unit --prefix site && npm run test:worker
